Question Choices: Select. What days comes after Monday? ~~Sunday | Saturday | Tuesday | Thursday | Friday | Wednesday~~
Hints: Count in order: Sunday Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday
Solution: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. The day after Monday is Tuesday.

Question Choices: Select. What days comes before Thursday? ~~Sunday | Saturday | Monday | Thursday | Friday | Wednesday~~
Hints: Count in order: Sunday Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday
Solution: The days go Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday. The day before Thursday is Wednesday.

Question Choices: Select. Today is Saturday. What day is it tomorrow? ~~Sunday | Monday | Tuesday | Thursday | Friday | Wednesday~~
Hints: Count in order: Sunday Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday. The start the next round. Sunday Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday
Solution: Saturday is followed by Sunday. If today is Saturday, tomorrow is Sunday.

Question Choices: Select. What season comes right before Summer? ~~Spring | Fall | Winter~~
Hints: Count in order: Spring Summer Fall Winter
Solution: The seasons cycle through spring, summer, fall and winter. Spring comes before summer.

Question Choices: Select. What season comes after fall? ~~Spring | Summer | Winter~~

Question Choices: Select. Which month comes right after November? ~~January | December | October~~
Hints: Count in order: January February March April May June July August September October November December

Question Choices: Select. What month comes right before April? ~~May | June | March | February~~
Hints: Count in order: January February March April May June July August September October November December
Solution: The months go February, March, April. March comes before April.

Question Choices: How many days are in 2 weeks.
Hints: One week is 7 days. Think: 2 weeks is 7 + 7 = ?
Solution: One week has 7 days. Two weeks have 7 + 7 = 14 days.

Question Choices: If the calendar shows the 1st day of the month on a Friday, what day is the 2nd?
Hints: The day right after Friday is Saturday
Solution: The second day is one day after the first. One day after Friday is Saturday.

Question Choices: Summer break is 2 weeks and 4 days from today. How many days is that in total?
Hints: One week is 7 days. What is 7 + 7 + 4?
Solution: Two weeks have 7 + 7 = 14 days. Add four more: 14 + 4 = 18 days.

Question Choices: Select. Which month is the shortest month in a year? ~~May | December | January | February~~
Hints: Which month has only 28 or 29 days? Most of the months has 30 or 31 days. But February only has 28 or 29 days. That is the shortest month.
Solution: February has 28 days in a common year and 29 in a leap year. Every other month has 30 or 31, so February is shortest.
